LanguageData.CER_LoadoutUtility_FetchGearButtonToolti: Every colonist with a loadout stops what they are doing and collects their missing gear right away - one item after another, until nothing is left.\n\nWithout this, CE lets them pick up one item every 30 seconds, only between jobs. LanguageData.CER_LoadoutUtility_AmmoStatTip:
Compared within this calibre - a full bar is the best variant of this ammo family.
Damage per shot: {0} (best: {1}) Sharp armour penetration: {2} (best: {3}) Blunt armour penetration: {4} (best: {5})
High damage with low sharp penetration suits unarmoured targets; high sharp penetration is what gets through armour and mechanoids. Blunt is the same for every round of a calibre - a bar that looks alike on all rows has nothing to choose.
